definitions.gloss: making into a habit; habituation; routinization
definitions.explanation: The process of turning an action or behavior into a regular habit or routine. Can refer to both deliberately forming a habit and the natural process of something becoming routine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習慣化|しゅうかんか}⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to make exercise a habit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{習慣化|しゅうかんか}してきた。
examples.english: My morning walks have become a habit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習慣化|しゅうかんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧とも{三週間|さんしゅうかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To make a new behavior a habit, you need to keep it up for at least three weeks.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧ (habit) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transformation suffix, '-ization'). A popular topic in self-improvement and productivity literature in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {習慣化|しゅうかんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to make into a habit; to become habitual
- {習慣化|しゅうかんか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コツ→コツ：06658_kotsu⟧ — tips for forming habits
- {習慣化|しゅうかんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧ — to succeed in forming a habit
- ⟦{早起|はやお}き→早起き：02477_hayaoki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{習慣化|しゅうかんか}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to make early rising a habit

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧ — habit, custom
- ⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧ — daily routine; refers to the established routine itself
- ⟦{癖|くせ}→癖：03814_kuse⟧ — habit (often unconscious or negative); unlike {習慣化|しゅうかんか}, not deliberately formed
- ルーティン — routine (loanword); increasingly common, especially in sports contexts
